decontamination_notes: cii-v2 OPAQUE-COMPONENT: CONJUNCTION-DARK variant with a COMPOSITE single-number output. The workspace ships a stripped compiled legacy toll/congestion rating engine (macOS-arm64 + linux-amd64, C source withheld in the task's builder/ dir alongside the hidden tests), a written spec that has deliberately drifted from it, and a naive Python replacement implemented faithfully FROM THE SPEC. Design emphasis: quirks live at arbitrary, unguessable conjunctions of two or three input dimensions, and each accepted passage emits ONE composite toll number, so a divergence never identifies which factor moved; the agent must decompose by controlled sweeps. Quirk inventory (all verified divergent from the naive base at build time): Q1 a three-dimension conjunction (gates 12-17 x class T x days 6-7) applying an undocumented 35% weekend freight bypass discount; Q2 the morning peak window starts 0645 instead of the documented 0700, but only at gates 30-40; Q8 the evening peak window ends 1929 instead of 1859, but only at gates 01-05; Q4 the peak multiplier is x1.9 for buses only (documented x2.0); Q3 class M with axles above 2 is silently rated as class C; Q5 the engine computes one integer basis-point product with a single half-even rounding while the naive rounds half-up twice (the spec just says nearest cent); tie cases are constructed on the Q1 path where base 250 or 450 times 1.8 times 0.65 lands on exact half cents (deliberate design deviation: with the published multipliers and axle-derived bases, ties are arithmetically impossible OFF the bypass path, so the rounding quirk is surfaced through Q1 conjunction fixtures instead of a standalone tie family); Q6 day-of-week 0 accepted as an alias for 7; Q7 hhmm 2400 accepted as 0000; Q9 trailing extra tokens tolerated, with FMT echoing the tagid when it parses and ?????????? otherwise. Validation order FMT, GATE, AXLES, TIME, DOW, CLASS is identical in engine, gold, and naive. Grading never executes the binary: all expected outputs were captured from it at build time into tests/fixtures.json (147 batches: 10 f2p families with boundary controls at gate 11/12/17/18, times 0644/0645/0659/0700 at gates 29/30, 1859/1900/1929/1930 at gates 05/06, dow 5/6, axles 2/3 for class M, plus two 120-record held-out parity corpora; 4 guard families pinned to gates 06-11 and 18-29, weekdays, classes C and T, no ties, exact tokens, covering everywhere the spec IS accurate). ANTI-DELEGATION: the hidden tests quarantine legacy/ out of the workspace for the whole session, so a replacement that shells out to the binary fails; the ticket states production does not ship it. Build-gate provenance: builder/gen_fixtures.py verified the gold Python matches the binary byte-for-byte on every fixture batch AND a 40-batch adversarial random sweep (boundary times, alias values, malformed lines), that the naive base diverges on every f2p family, and that it agrees on every guard batch; the gate exits 1 on any violation and passed with problems: 0. Fully deterministic (static fixtures, no state across records, no wall clock). Graded skill: experimental characterization of a black box via multi-dimensional controlled sweeps, not code reading.
